name: precull-subset
description: Pose-free pre-cull (STO-SCN-092): from the whole image pool, derive a curated candidate SUBSET by sharpness + perceptual-hash dedup (no poses), preserving path revisits and bounding temporal gaps. Opt-in side-branch (not in the default ingest chain); does not change `primary` unless explicitly requested. The subset it produces is what STO-SCN-093 poses.

target.note: candidate count ceiling (0 = no thin); 300 = measured 16GB solve ceiling

phash_thresh.note: Hamming distance under which consecutive frames are near-duplicates

blur_rel.note: drop frames below this fraction of median sharpness

max_gap.note: max retained temporal index gap (coverage/connectivity guard)

dup_window.note: dedup is local to this window so revisits survive
